boundary: This is an exact necessary condition on the two-pencil factorization. It cuts dirty-pair type assignments sharply but leaves the same nine histogram families in all three dirty-centre relations, so it does not by itself improve tau_2 beyond [111,115].
crossTrackE6Anchor: W33-Theory w33_pass7305_7306_cspread_intrinsic_double_six.py and w33_pass7307_7309_double_six_naimark_isometry.py identify these same 36 spreads equivariantly with the 36 Schlaefli double-sixes/Pfaffian sections. That identification is imported, not re-proved here.
sectionIdentity: For each spread D, the number R_D of dirty row token-pairs whose two points lie on one line of D equals s(a,b) for the unique dirty column in D, where s=4/1/0 for equal/collinear/noncollinear tokens. The row/column-dual identity holds simultaneously.
